changelog:
StoreTap v2.1.0.12.0 Major Update!

🔧 BUG FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS:
- Fixed critical data duplication bug during Offline -> Online sync.
- Implemented race condition lock to prevent double-charging inventory.
- Fixed offline stock display delays.

✨ NEW FEATURES:
- Built a brand new System Settings page with real-time clock adjustment.
- Implemented Over-The-Air (OTA) update mechanism. You can now update StoreTap seamlessly!
- Moved central Licensing checks to a global layout to ensure smooth operation across all pages.
- Re-architected offlineStorage.js to be globally accessible and more reliable.
